defs.def: an organized set of data that is stored in a computer and can be looked at and used in various ways （贮存在计算机中的）数据库，资料库

ex.s: Analyses of a language database also confirmed that there was a global change in the sound of world languages after the Neolithic age, with the use of “f” and “v” increasing remarkably during the last few thousand years.
ex.t: 对一个语言数据库的分析也证实，新石器时代之后世界语言的声音发生了全球性的变化，"f"和"v"的使用在近几千年显著增加。

ex.s: Your application will be accessed by UNESCO managers and will stay in our database for six months．We do not respond to every candidate．If selected，you will be contacted by a manager．If you do not receive any update within six months，it means that your application has not been successful．
ex.t: 你的申请将由联合国教科文组织的经理审阅，并在我们的数据库中保留六个月。我们不会回复每一位候选人。如果被选中，会有经理与你联系。如果六个月内未收到任何更新，则意味着你的申请未获成功。

ex.s: aim at victims precisely     B. damage databases easily
ex.t: 精确瞄准受害者 B. 容易破坏数据库

ex.s: We can get the most updated information from large databases.
ex.t: 我们可以从大型数据库获取最新信息。

ex.s: Later, we created a database of their fins and locations.
ex.t: 后来，我们建立了一个关于它们鳍和位置的数据库。

ex.s: It has been one of the key weapons for unsolved cases.The DNAis stored in a database, where policemen can find the same orsimilarDNAtotrackdownsuspectsand victims.
ex.t: 它一直是侦破悬案的关键武器之一。DNA 储存在数据库中，警察可在其中找到相同或相似的DNA来追踪嫌疑人和受害者。

ex.s: It works by comparing the facial features of given images with those in a database.
ex.t: 它的工作原理是将给定图像的人脸特征与数据库中的特征进行比对。
